newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to seek support at 103.08.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to seek support at 103.08.

text.p: September notionnel futures on MATIF have broken through support in early trading on Friday, and are heading lower, technical analysts said.
"The contract will carry on trading downwards," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
"We have gone through support at 130.60, which suggests there is a top in place at the contract high," he added.

September notionnel made an all-time high of 131.24 on Wednesday. By 0731 GMT, the contract fell 26 basis points to 130.52. The low of 130.08 reached on July 21 will provide the next support, Branigan said.
"Notionnel has seen its highs for now," said Elli Gifford, independent technical analyst near Cambridge.
"There is a central area of support around 130.40, with real support at 130.00."
Branigan found further support at 129.80, the low of July 15. "Slow stochastics confirm the weakness," he said.
On the upside, the contract needs to break back above 130.74, the current session high, for further strength, Branigan said.
Next stop would then be Thursday's high of 131.16, "to target the contract high and beyond," he added.
Gifford found resistance at the psychological 131.00, ahead of the 131.24 contract high.
September Pibor futures were at 96.50 at 0743 GMT, down two basis points.
